name: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act
authority: U.S. Department of Health and Human Services (HHS)
description: HIPAA establishes national standards for the protection of health information. The Security Rule requires appropriate administrative, physical, and technical safeguards to ensure confidentiality, integrity, and availability of electronic protected health information (ePHI).

domains.name: Administrative Safeguards
domains.description: Administrative actions, policies, and procedures to manage security measures

domains.name: Physical Safeguards
domains.description: Physical measures, policies, and procedures to protect electronic systems

domains.name: Technical Safeguards
domains.description: Technology and policies for protecting and controlling access to ePHI

domains.name: Organizational Requirements
domains.description: Requirements for business associate contracts and group health plans

metadata.notes: Security Rule applies to covered entities and business associates
